subject: Boreal Health — outcomes summary & reference request for renewal expansion
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holden <sara.holden@borealhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short outcomes summary & permission to use metrics for renewal pack

Hi Sara —

Hope you’re well. As we prepare Boreal’s renewal conversation with the expansion pricing team, we’d like to assemble a short impact packet (one-pager + optional customer quote) that quantifies the value Boreal has realized with Redwood. The pack is used during renewal and to support an internal upsell request.

Could you please confirm by next Tuesday if you’re comfortable sharing the following: 
- 2–3 bullet metrics we can show (e.g., latency improvement vs prior infra, cost per 1M tokens, reduction in inference errors or time-to-insight)
- A 1–2 sentence quote we can attribute to Boreal Health (we’ll send for sign-off)

If easier, feel free to send a short spreadsheet — I attached a simple template we can fill. We’ll draft the one-pager and send back to you for approval before anything goes public.

Thanks again for the partnership — appreciate any quick help here.

Best,
Logan Wright\Account Executive\Redwood Inference
attachments: boreal_q1_metrics.csv (template)
From: Sara Holden <sara.holden@borealhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@borealhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short outcomes summary & permission to use metrics for renewal pack

Hi Logan —

Happy to help. I pulled together the top-line metrics our analytics team tracks — see below and attached export. Quick notes: numbers are for Q1 (Jan–Mar) after the migration to Redwood dedicated pool.

- Average tail latency (95th): down from 320ms -> 95ms (70% reduction)
- Avg cost per 1M tokens: ~$36 -> ~$12 (66% reduction)
- Time to generate clinician summary (median): 28s -> 9s (68% faster)
- User-reported summary accuracy (NPS sample): +8 pts month-over-month

I’m attaching the CSV with the raw values (boreal_q1_metrics.csv). I’m ok with a short quote along the lines of: "Redwood helped us scale clinical summarization with material latency and cost improvements while improving clinician satisfaction."

If you want a slightly stronger line on ROI we’ll need to loop in finance for a dollars-saved calc — Alex (cc’d) can help with that.

—Sara
Chief Product Officer\Boreal Health
attachments: boreal_q1_metrics.csv
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Drafting Boreal impact one-pager and quote approval path

Team —

Sara sent the Q1 metrics (attached). Boreal is a strong upsell candidate; the renewal conversation next month will hinge on convincing procurement we’ve delivered measurable unit economics. I’m proposing the following deliverables:
1) One-page impact summary (metrics + 1-sentence quote) — public-facing after approval
2) Internal ROI slide that ties metrics to estimated ops cost savings (for sales/AE pack)
3) Signed short testimonial (DocuSign) to include in case studies and the renewal packet

Actions: Monica — can you draft the one-pager + a short draft quote for legal review? Priyom — can you estimate 6- and 12-month cost savings using the attached CSV (simple model)? I’ll coordinate sending to Sara for sign-off.

Timeline: aim to have internal drafts by EOD 4/19 so we can share with Sara 4/20.

Thanks,
Logan
attachments: boreal_q1_metrics.csv

"Redwood helped Boreal Health reduce inference latency by 70% and inference costs by two-thirds, enabling clinicians to receive summaries in under 10 seconds and improve workflow satisfaction. The result was measurable time savings across clinical teams and a faster triage process."

Impact bullets (public-facing):

• 66% lower cost per 1M tokens ($36 -> $12)

--- end draft excerpt ---

I attached the Word doc (draft_case_study.docx) and a plain-text short quote (boreal_quote_draft.txt). If legal is okay, we can send this to Sara for a one-line sign-off and DocuSign.

Monica
